item.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO amid scandal after Trump, tech allies pressure board
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returned to his post on Monday, less than two weeks after resigning over a scandal involving an affair with a customer and suspected Chinese spy, as well as a second reported affair with a subordinate. item.title: Measles cases surge in U.S., raising questions about boosters and public health system
item.description: On Nov. 17, the Pan American Health Organization declared that measles is no longer considered "eliminated" in the United States, after the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recorded more than 5,800 cases in the past year — the highest caseload since 1991.
